description: Initial bounded synthetic model profile. JSON Schema checks structure; the C++ loader also checks ordered limits and integration work bounds.

model.description: Synthetic point kinematics, independent horizontal speed and vertical-rate limits; no aerodynamic envelope claim.

navigation.description: Explicit test-only exact navigation with zero covariance; realism is not established.

flight_envelope.description: Flight-model-owned bounds; corresponding planner profile must not permit a wider envelope.

max_speed_mps.description: Maximum horizontal ground speed, m/s; not total airspeed.

max_acceleration_mps2.description: Maximum increase in horizontal ground speed, m/s^2.

max_deceleration_mps2.description: Maximum decrease in horizontal ground speed, m/s^2.

max_turn_rate_radps.description: Maximum heading rate, radians/s clockwise from north.

max_climb_rate_mps.description: Maximum increase in WGS-84 HAE altitude, m/s.

max_descent_rate_mps.description: Maximum decrease in WGS-84 HAE altitude, positive m/s magnitude.

min_altitude_hae_m.description: Minimum WGS-84 height above ellipsoid, m.

max_altitude_hae_m.description: Maximum WGS-84 height above ellipsoid, m.

guidance.description: Geometric waypoint guidance; timed constraints are rejected until supported.

waypoint_capture_radius_m.description: 3D waypoint capture distance in ECEF metres; capture includes intersection during a substep.

integration.description: Bound numerical work without wall-clock pacing dependencies.

max_substep_ns.description: Maximum elapsed simulation nanoseconds per numerical substep; split earlier at events/output deadlines.

max_interval_ns.description: Largest admitted advancing clock interval, simulation nanoseconds.

max_substeps_per_interval.description: Work bound including extra splits; exhaust before publishing a partial interval.

publication.description: Independent schedules starting with an initial t=0 sample; enabled/reporting identities are supplied by scenario installation.

dis_period_ns.description: Periodic physical DIS sample spacing in scenario nanoseconds.

prd_period_ns.description: Periodic local navigation report spacing in scenario nanoseconds.
